latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Leonardo — generate 1080p video clips from product photos or text prompts in seconds.

- Instantly turn images or text descriptions into server-rendered 1080p MP4 video clips.
- Handles uploads of common media file types (images, video, audio).
- Automatic backend session setup, with free trial credits if no API token is present.
- Simple workflows for generating, editing, previewing, and exporting video.
- Clear error handling and status updates throughout the pipeline.
- Built-in support for querying credits, timeline state, and export status.
